svg.title: Legacy and SegWit output structure
svg.desc: Both outputs have an amount, a script length, and a scriptPubKey. The P2PKH scriptPubKey is a full locking script. The P2WPKH scriptPubKey holds only a witness version, OP_0, and a witness program, the 20-byte HASH160 of K_B.
